access_basis.license_notice: LICENSE has NC-SA link/header but NC body; preserve exact notice
access_basis.use: public release, research-only endpoint inspection; no commercial permission inferred

configuration.aggregate_weighting: unique canonical endpoint; not an equal-run or population estimate
configuration.precision: integer topology counts; float64 reported scores
configuration.randomness: none; no random seed or stochastic computation
configuration.ring_basis: RDKit symmetrized SSSR; cycle rank reported separately
configuration.seed_mapping: target-local file idx indexes target-filtered GENMOL_T4_SEEDS registry
configuration.selection: upstream strict sim > delta, qed > 0.6, sa < 4; max docking score per seed
configuration.source_mapping_check: compare reported winner similarity with Morgan r2/2048 Tanimoto; not used for winner selection
configuration.split: all inspected cells are development evidence, not an untouched final holdout
configuration.ties: all canonically distinct co-best endpoints, with every duplicate source row

evidence_role: computed development-only endpoint census; not prospective validation
limitations: Only similarity-constrained T4; unconstrained T4 and other tasks are not pooled.
Scores and feasibility are reported by IVG; no redocking or oracle-parity claim.
Endpoint deltas do not establish edit histories, reachability, or causal docking effects.
Ring-taxonomy labels overlap; fused includes shared-atom cases also labelled bridged.
40-atom, charge, and stereo flags are partial support checks, not executor admission.
Canonical identity retains specified stereochemistry; no 3D or stereo-generation claim.
No winner fragments, frequencies, or labels are fed to the controller or a learned model.
